value: Time-series momentum at 1-week to 1-year horizons on the 5 majors, expressed as a 9-lookback daily ensemble that adjusts exposure about once a day.

Per market and lookback L in {5,10,20,30,60,90,150,250,360} days: long when the daily close exceeds the prior L-day high, out when it falls below the running max of the L-day midpoint; each sub-sleeve sized at entry to 25% annualised vol (cap 2x); long only.
